newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African police arrest serial killer suspect.
newsitem.headline: S.African police arrest serial killer suspect.

text.p: South African police announced on Wednesday they had arrested their seventh serial killer suspect in two years.

The 31-year-old man, accused of involvement in the rape and murder of six women, was being held in police custody while detectives probed other killings which could later be linked to him, Inspector Andy Pieke said in a statement.
He will be named when he appears in court on September 25 in connection with the killings, which date from 1993 and occurred in both the Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal regions of South Africa.
Police have investigated six other serial killings in two years: three around Johannesburg, two in Cape Town and one in the Zulu heartland of the KwaZulu-Natal region.

In a country already dubbed the most violent in the world outside of a war zone, the killings have terrified the nation, particularly people in and around Johannesburg where 51 of the estimated 74 serial murders have occurred.
